from collections import deque
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    r2=[r for r in range(h) if all(x==2 for x in g[r])][0]
    down = r2==h-1
    # objects: connected components of same nonzero color, excluding 2-row
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c] and g[r][c]!=2 and (r,c) not in seen:
                col=g[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and (na,nb) not in seen and g[na][nb]==col:
                            seen.add((na,nb)); q.append((na,nb))
                objs.append((col,cells))
    occ=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    occ[r2]=[True]*w
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    out[r2]=[2]*w
    placed=[]
    # place objects one by one, bottom-most first (gravity order), each falls until blocked
    def key(o):
        col,cells=o
        return max(r for r,c in cells) if down else -min(r for r,c in cells)
    for col,cells in sorted(objs,key=key):
        cur=cells
        d=1 if down else -1
        while True:
            nxt=[(r+d,c) for r,c in cur]
            if any(not(0<=r<h) or occ[r][c] for r,c in nxt): break
            cur=nxt
        for r,c in cur: occ[r][c]=True; out[r][c]=col
    return out

src='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    g=grid; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if all(x==2 for x in g[r])]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==2 for r in range(h))]
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c] and g[r][c]!=2 and (r,c) not in seen:
                col=g[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and (na,nb) not in seen and g[na][nb]==col:
                            seen.add((na,nb)); q.append((na,nb))
                objs.append((col,cells))
    occ=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    if rows:
        r2=rows[0]; d=1 if r2==h-1 else -1
        for c in range(w): occ[r2][c]=True; out[r2][c]=2
        def step(cells): return [(r+d,c) for r,c in cells]
        def ok(cells): return all(0<=r<h and not occ[r][c] for r,c in cells)
        key=lambda o: max(r for r,c in o[1])*d
    else:
        c2=cols[0]; d=1 if c2==w-1 else -1
        for r in range(h): occ[r][c2]=True; out[r][c2]=2
        def step(cells): return [(r,c+d) for r,c in cells]
        def ok(cells): return all(0<=c<w and not occ[r][c] for r,c in cells)
        key=lambda o: max(c for r,c in o[1])*d
    for col,cells in sorted(objs,key=key,reverse=True):
        cur=cells
        while ok(step(cur)): cur=step(cur)
        for r,c in cur: occ[r][c]=True; out[r][c]=col
    return out
'''
